scenarios.description: Materialize a fresh blobless no-checkout clone with reset --hard HEAD over smart HTTP

detail.setup: remote http://127.0.0.1:35061/remote.git served by git http-backend (git's own smart HTTP server)
detail.prepare:
set -e
rm -rf /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-remote-git-git/remote.git-reset '/tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-remote-git-git/remote.grit-reset'
git clone -q --filter=blob:none --no-checkout http://127.0.0.1:35061/remote.git '/tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-remote-git-git/remote.git-reset'
grit clone --blobs none --no-checkout http://127.0.0.1:35061/remote.git '/tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-remote-git-git/remote.grit-reset'
detail.correctness: before timing, git and grit were each run once and their results compared

scenarios.description: Pop 3k edits in a mostly unchanged 120k-file tree vs git stash pop

detail.prepare:
set -eu
cd /tmp/grit-bench-scratch/daily-stash-pop-sparse
git reset --hard -q 'HEAD'
git stash 'clear'
git stash store -m 'sparse edits' "$(git rev-parse 'refs/grit-bench/stash-sparse')"
